LightningComponentBundle.description: Generic document upload card for Document_CheckList__c flows. Pass application, applicant, document type, and checklist Id via @api attributes.

property.name: subtitle
property.label: Subtitle
property.description: Helper text when no file is uploaded

property.name: documentChecklistId
property.label: Document Checklist Id

property.name: applicationId
property.label: Application Id
property.description: Application__c Id for auto-link on upload

property.name: applicantId
property.label: Applicant Id
property.description: Applicant__c Id for auto-link on upload

property.name: documentType
property.label: Document Type
property.description: Document_Type__c value for auto-link on upload
